summary: @gyomu/tsdoc is an automated system designed to maintain and update JSDoc documentation within TypeScript projects. It leverages project state snapshots and file change detection to orchestrate precise updates to source code documentation.
responsibilities: Manage the lifecycle and persistence of project source file snapshots for consistent state tracking.
Perform change detection between file snapshots to identify modified project segments.
Orchestrate the end-to-end workflow of generating, merging, and applying documentation updates.
Provide reliable path mapping utilities between source files and build outputs to ensure documentation coherence.
Define stable data models for project identity and workspace metadata in monorepo environments.

capabilities.name: Project State Tracking
capabilities.description: Enables the capturing, committing, and diffing of file system snapshots to detect changes across project iterations.

capabilities.name: JSDoc Automation
capabilities.description: Automates the generation and reconciliation of JSDoc comments by applying structured merge plans to existing source files.

capabilities.name: Path Resolution Utilities
capabilities.description: Provides tools for normalizing paths and mapping relationships between source files and their corresponding build artifacts.

designDecisions: Uses snapshot-based state management to facilitate deterministic change detection in dynamic monorepo environments.
Employs a merge-plan abstraction to decouple documentation generation from the physical application of file edits.
Utilizes a workspace-based architecture to anchor documentation updates to specific project identifiers and repository contexts.
Modularizes path transformation logic to ensure consistency across build output mapping and documentation target identification.
usageGuidance: Initialize project workspaces using the provided snapshotting tools before running documentation updates to ensure state accuracy.
Use the path mapping utilities whenever logic involves moving between source and build file systems to maintain compatibility.
Integrate the update workflow as part of a post-analysis phase to ensure JSDoc modifications reflect the latest project state.
Rely on the provided identity structures (Project IDs) to manage documentation artifacts consistently within monorepo monorepo setups.
